Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds mentioned in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary through compound_records on molregno, then join compound_structures as an inner join to enforce availability of canonical SMILES. Filter by document CHEMBL1123859. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort rows by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
